title: Hearth-Charter Broker
text: Hearth-Charter Broker offers a stamped claim to warm shelter, then reaches for anything carried across the threshold. On loss, suffer 1 Wound.

defeatReward.text: Hearth-Charter Broker is defeated and its identifying marks are entered into your Trophy Pile.
